authority: user request 17 Oct 2026: freeze the final method set and analysis plan before any final-task data is read; one offline run on the 2 final tasks x 3 seeds; nothing tuned after it
compute_measures: decision latency (ms, batch 1), FLOPs and peak GPU memory per decision
one-time shared costs: reference feature cache and source training (reported, not charged to methods)

data.package: source tasks + final tasks only (no development data)
data.query: the 20 registered query demos per task, real recorded future frames; no generator, no simulator
data.tasks: the 2 registered final_test tasks of protocol v6 (LIBERO-Goal)

held_out_claims_note: The final tasks were never used for design or tuning, but the VPP2 generator saw LIBERO during its training. This offline benchmark does not use VPP2 (real recorded futures); the protocol flag stays false.

inference.decision_rule: better if the cluster interval lies entirely below 0; worse if entirely above 0; otherwise no clear difference
inference.difference: ours minus baseline per (task, seed, demo); negative = ours better
inference.multiplicity: all P1-P2 comparisons are reported; no correction; P1 and P2 at 25 updates are the headline comparisons
inference.primary_interval: 95% percentile bootstrap over the 6 task x seed clusters (cluster value = mean paired difference over its 20 demos), 10,000 resamples, Python random.Random(0)
inference.secondary_interval: 95% bootstrap over individual demo pairs (optimistic; reported for continuity)
inference.settings_won: number of the 6 clusters with mean difference < 0

baseline_definitions.regent_weight: exp(-L * retrieval distance of the nearest support transition)
baseline_definitions.strap_batches: half support rows, half retrieved rows
baseline_definitions.strap_pool: source_train demos of every source task (frozen reference features)

exploratory_included.raid_v7_head: defined after development results; included as a frozen method, labelled exploratory

raid_v7_head.evaluation: retrieval over the full support bank; frozen features
raid_v7_head.retrieval: k=16 over the five-shot support bank; each training row excludes its own demo
raid_v7_head.schedule: identical to head_only: 500 updates, batch 64, head lr 3e-4, AdamW wd 1e-4, grad clip 1.0, same sample stream (v6adapt key)

v7.gate: per action dimension, sigmoid, forced to 1 without valid candidates
v7.keys: frozen reference features of each candidate (normalized) and its similarity

metrics.mse: chunk MSE on normalized actions, macro over the 20 query demos per task
metrics.r2: mean over 7 action dimensions of 1 - SSE/SST over all query chunk elements
metrics.unit_of_analysis: per (task, seed, query demo) MSE; macro over demos within a task x seed setting

name: raid_fewshot_idm_final_analysis_plan

P1.rule: lowest mean development MSE among support_knn_average, retrieve_and_play, regent_blend
P1.what: RAID v7 (raid_bank_v7) vs the best training-free baseline, no training

P2.rule: lowest mean development MSE at that update count among raid_lora_v7, raid_lora_mlp, raid_v7_head
P2.what: best RAID variant vs each baseline, at 25 updates and at 500 updates

P3.error_at_budget_rule: MSE of the last checkpoint whose adaptation seconds <= budget (training-free methods at 0 s)
P3.time_to_target: GPU-seconds to reach LoRA's 500-update final-task mean MSE (linear between checkpoints)
P3.what: per-GPU-second curves: mean MSE vs adaptation GPU-seconds for every method (descriptive)

rules: one run; resume of the same run after an interruption is allowed, a second run is not
nothing is tuned, re-selected or re-run after the final run; all results are reported, including negative ones
closed-loop task success is separate secondary evidence (optional step 4, needs user approval and funds)
secondary: R2 for every method and checkpoint
